scientific_question: Does the complete terminal expert c_fc tensor have learned multiplicative layer/expert/hidden/input structure that a global tensor train can represent at at least 200x c_fc compression, after fixed-frame spectral reweighting failed to identify its pre-GELU directions?

composition_result.finding: Mapped QK plus dense complete experts passes its 5TPP confirmation by -0.0443222523 CE, but it does not compress either expert matrix.

spectral_rejection.finding: Two learned spectra improve heldout expert-output recovery over the fixed orthogonal control by about 0.145, but mean recovery remains about 0.382 and pre-GELU direction recovery is near zero. Fixed pseudo-random directions are therefore insufficient even when reweighted.

causal_reconciliation.directed_product_and_state_boundary: The directed-product c_fc oracle demonstrates useful task-selected directions but retains dense c_fc weights and dense-scale Muon history. The procedural-state frontier cannot encode that history even beyond dense-state byte cost. This candidate instead represents the weights directly in compact learned coordinates and has no dense c_fc base or optimizer state.
causal_reconciliation.write_map_boundary: Attention V/O and expert c_proj remain dense full-state residual-write exceptions. This oracle changes only the expert c_fc read map and retains terminal router and dense c_proj exactly.
causal_reconciliation.why_tensor_train: Unlike diagonal modulation of a fixed BlockFHT frame, every tensor-train core learns directions. Interleaving hidden and input radix modes makes cross-axis direction coupling local in the chain, while the equal-coordinate separated-axis control tests whether that coupling rather than coordinate count explains recovery.
causal_reconciliation.not_lora: The constraint is tensor-train bond rank across the complete layer-by-expert c_fc tensor, not ordinary matrix rank. It can materialize full-rank expert matrices, stores no learned dense basis, and adds no dense or low-rank residual.

source.terminal_gauge: Use the complete terminal c_fc tensor for the endpoint decomposition. Collect heldout MLP inputs with the complete terminal model and use its terminal router and terminal dense expert c_proj on both target and candidate sides.

mechanism.optimizer_state_rule: Any later implementation must optimize only TT cores and may not retain a dense c_fc base, dense c_fc gradient accumulator, or dense c_fc optimizer history.

equal_coordinate_control.name: separated_axis_tensor_train
equal_coordinate_control.purpose: Hold learned-coordinate count and endpoint access fixed while removing local hidden/input radix coupling.

decomposition_protocol.kind: optimistic endpoint randomized TT-SVD upper bound
decomposition_protocol.algorithm: At each TT split, compute a seeded randomized left range, perform the Rayleigh-Ritz eigendecomposition of its small Gram matrix, retain the frozen capped bond rank, and propagate U^T times the unfolding. Full feasible bonds use the exact left Gram or QR path.
decomposition_protocol.selection: Use the terminal cores emitted by each registered decomposition seed. There is no activation fitting, heldout selection, rank sweep, or checkpoint update.
decomposition_protocol.storage: Save compact TT cores and scalar diagnostics only. Stream reconstructed expert matrices for scoring and never persist a dense candidate tensor.

functional_protocol.anti_leakage: Heldout activations never affect TT cores, ranks, seeds, mode order, stopping, or thresholds. Both decomposition seeds and both heldout banks are reported without selection.

metrics.primary: Heldout exact routed-MoE layer-output recovery, 1-||candidate-target||^2/||target||^2, using terminal routing and exact dense c_proj.
secondary: global and per-layer c_fc parameter recovery
same-heldout action cosine between independently decomposed TT seeds

decision_rule.pass: Passing every frozen gate for both decomposition seeds and both heldout banks authorizes only a production TT c_fc implementation, correctness tests, and a separately preregistered initialization-fit shadow check. It does not authorize language-model training.
decision_rule.representability_fail: Reject this exact 200x global rank-150 TT family. Do not sweep bond rank, factorization, axis order, random seed, power iterations, or thresholds without a new residual decomposition.
decision_rule.control_fail: If absolute recovery passes but the equal-coordinate interleaved gain does not, the result does not identify cross-axis coupling as causal and does not authorize implementation.
decision_rule.systems: Run an exact-shape runtime preflight first. Foreground-poll only while total observed runtime remains under five minutes; at five minutes install a terminal-or-error watchdog with an explicit @Codex continuation prompt.
